# rms_company (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a single Teltonika RMS Company.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_company" "main" {
  id = 1
}

output "company_name" {
  value = data.rms_company.main.company_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The company ID.

### Read-Only

- `company_name` (String) The company name.
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `device_count` (Number) The number of devices.
- `parent_id` (Number) The parent company ID.
